title: Answer: consciousness is observed from the third person, through subjects’ beliefs

statements.text: The view takes no position on measurement in physics. Consciousness is observed by heterophenomenology: subjects’ reports are interpreted into catalogues of their beliefs about experience, which, with brain and environmental data, are the whole data set. Introspection is not a privileged observation of inner properties, and it cannot check its own accuracy.

sources.quote: comprise the total data set for a theory of human consciousness
But we have no introspective way of checking the accuracy of our introspective representations
